title: Squaring Numbers That End in 5
summary: A pattern is only a rule once you can explain why it works.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: There is a fast way that needs only one small multiplication.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Split the number into the tens part and the 5 at the end.
Try 15 times 15, which is 225, and 25 times 25, which is 625. Look at how the answers start and end.
points: Split the number into the tens part and the 5 at the end.

steps.title: The method: Find the rule, then test it
sentences: Take the tens digit, and multiply it by the next number up.
Write that, then write 25 after it.
For 35: 3 times 4 is 12, so the answer is 1225.
points: Take the tens digit, and multiply it by the next number up.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: 85 times 85: 8 times 9 is 72, so the answer is 7225.
It works because (10n plus 5) squared equals 100 times n times (n plus 1), plus 25.
Always test a rule on a case you already know, like 15 times 15 equals 225.

method: Find the rule, then test it
